sources.title: InsideEVs - 2024 Kia EV9 Fast Charging Test
sources.notes: 2024 EV9 GT-Line AWD (99.8 kWh) on a 350 kW Electrify America charger; peak 216 kW; text gives power at several SoC points. Temperature and preconditioning not stated.

sources.title: EverCars - 2026 Hyundai IONIQ 9 charging test 10-80% results
sources.notes: EverTV test, 400 kW charger, car arrived at 5% and timer started at 10%; 211 kW at 10%, 235 kW peak at 60%, 124 kW at 80%, 23 min 19 s for 10-80%. Trim not stated; car did not allow preconditioning.

sources.title: Electrek - 2026 Hyundai IONIQ 9 review
sources.notes: 110.3 kWh NMC pack; up to ~237 kW at a 350 kW 800 V station, 10-80% in 24 min (relays Hyundai figures).

sources.title: EV Database - Hyundai IONIQ 9 Long Range RWD
sources.notes: European listing: 110.3 kWh nominal, 106.0 kWh usable, 11 kW AC onboard charger. Same pack worldwide; Canadian onboard charger not confirmed.

sources.title: EV Specifications - 2026 Hyundai IONIQ 9 RWD S
sources.notes: US RWD S: 19-inch 8Jx19 wheels with 255/60R19 tires, RWD.

sources.title: EV Database - Kia EV9 99.8 kWh AWD
sources.notes: 96.0 kWh usable (estimated), 99.8 kWh nominal, Kia claimed max 210 kW DC, 24 min 10-80% claim, 11 kW AC.

sources.title: EV Database - Kia EV9 99.8 kWh AWD GT
sources.notes: GT: 96.0 kWh usable, 99.8 kWh nominal, 206 kW DC (matches Kia Australia spec sheet per Zecar), 11 kW AC. European listing.

sources.title: EV Database - Kia EV9 76.1 kWh RWD
sources.notes: 76.1 kWh nominal, 73.0 kWh usable, 11 kW AC. Peak DC listed 210 kW (conflicts with 230-240 kW elsewhere).

sources.title: EV Seekers - Kia EV9 battery and charging
sources.notes: States both the 76.1 kWh and 99.8 kWh packs use NMC cells supplied by SK On.

sources.title: Edwards Auto Group - 2026 Kia EV9 Light specs (US)
sources.notes: US dealer spec sheet: 19-inch alloy, 255/60R19, onboard charger 10.9, NACS port.

sources.title: Edwards Auto Group - 2026 Kia EV9 Wind specs (US)
sources.notes: US dealer spec sheet: 19-inch alloy, 255/60R19, onboard charger 10.9, 10-80% 24 min at 350 kW (83 min at 50 kW). US Wind is AWD.

sources.title: Edwards Auto Group - 2026 Kia EV9 Land specs (US)
sources.notes: US dealer spec sheet: 20-inch alloy, 275/50R20, onboard charger 10.9, 10-80% 24 min at 350 kW.

sources.title: Edwards Auto Group - 2026 Kia EV9 GT-Line specs (US)
sources.notes: US dealer spec sheet: 21-inch alloy, 285/45R21, onboard charger 10.9, NACS port.

sources.title: Kia Canada - EV9 GT Canadian unveiling (Montreal International Auto Show)
sources.notes: Kia Canada release: 21-inch alloy wheels with 285/45R21 tires; 800 V charging 10-80% in less than 25 minutes; 160 kW front + 270 kW rear motors.

sources.title: Kia owner manual (MV1, 2026) - Battery conditioning mode
sources.notes: Manual switch to turn battery conditioning on/off; setting a fast charger as waypoint/destination conditions the battery for arrival. Applies only to vehicles with a battery heater. MV1 is the EV9 (en_US MV1 specs page lists the 76.1/99.8 kWh packs and EV9 trims). UK copy of the page.

battery.chemistry.notes: Review says 110.3 kWh NMC pack (relayed; NCM/NMC are the same family). Same pack across the three variants.

battery.capacity_usable_kwh.notes: European listing for the same 110.3 kWh pack: 106.0 kWh usable (other sites say 106.3 or 107). Pack is common to all markets. Conflict: the awd and awd-performance records hold 99.5 kWh (OpenEV) for the same 110.3 kWh pack; not reconciled.

ac_max_kw.notes: European listing: 11 kW (3-phase 16 A). Canadian onboard charger not confirmed on a Canadian page.

dc_max_kw.notes: Electrek review states up to ~237 kW on a 350 kW 800 V charger, not attributed to Hyundai; the same article measured nearly 215 kW. Third-party figures range 233-250 kW.

wheels.notes: US RWD S listing (the only RWD trim); Canadian Standard assumed to be the same trim, not confirmed on a Canadian page.

curves.notes: Sparse (3 points) EverTV test of a 2026 IONIQ 9, trim not stated; shape between points is a straight-line assumption. Peak 235 kW at 60%. Car did not allow preconditioning. Electrek measured a lower peak (~215 kW) on a different charger; InsideEVs relays 243 kW with no SoC points. Timer started at 10% after arriving at 5%.
